title: Esthetic bugs on version 3.0.0.1 graph
symptom: On version 3.0.0.1 (master), the last reading is displayed on top but not on the graph, and more rarely only part of the graph (the most updated part) is displayed. Both problems are resolved by switching the graph to 24hr and back to 3hr view.
fix: The thread does not state a specific fix; it mentions that the second point has been solved in dev and that the issue is hopefully resolved in dev.
evidence_quote: The second point has been solved in dev.
